basic_info.description: Sophisticated and spacious three-bedroom, two and a half-bath townhome with stylish updates, serene views, and situated in a peaceful and secure setting by the San Francisco Golf Club! The dramatic entryway opens to soaring ceilings and a contemporary chandelier sets the tenor for this special home characterized by a cherished and traditional floor plan coupled with contemporary 21st century design. The main level offers a large light-filled and open living area with large south facing windows and cascading natural light overlooking the private deck, a fireplace, gorgeous wood floors, dining area, a large gourmet eat-in kitchen, a conveniently located  bath, all showered with natural light. The upper level of the home presents the perfect floor plan with two bedrooms with views and ample closet space, a full-sized bathroom, and a large master suite all on the same level and benefiting from plenty of natural light. Do not miss this special home with a large garage that has the potential for future expansion, 24-hour security, a well-managed HOA, swimming pool, spa, tennis courts, and is close to parks, playgrounds, golf courses, shopping, HWY 101/280 and more!
